scope: One saved-only 191-chunk/three-panel audit after complete immutable artifact pins; independent predictions, integer labels/cross-tabs, scalar-fsum metrics and beta-CDF inversion. No author imports, RNN, normal draws, refits or SVD.
resource_scope: One19/20CPU process,2GiB,one thread under review lock; preserve any failure, no automatic retry.
checks: Exact expected chunk sequence and pilot once; raw archive byte hashes/shapes/dtypes and source pins
Independent raw rank/state metadata, three-term lookup and sparse two-term separable prediction, exact first-index labels
Independent per-observation scoring, disjoint error tables, hidden metrics, fixed-model individual intervals
Training normal-equation residual is diagnostic only; singular values structurally checked, not independently factorized
RNG transitions and actual recurrent hidden states are provenance checks, not independently replayed
Complete saved outcomes required before artifact pinning/execution
